title: 大语言模型辅助交通管理计划编制：WisDOT WisTMP系统案例研究
summary: 本文提出基于大语言模型的交通管理计划（TMP）自动生成框架，以WisDOT WisTMP系统为应用场景。通过将历史PDF文档转为结构化问答数据集，对多个开源LLM进行微调并本地部署以保障数据安全。实验表明微调显著提升文本生成性能，但模型存在策略过度生成、缺乏项目针对性论证和成本估算不准等问题，且从7B/8B扩展到14B收益有限。
summary_en: This paper proposes an LLM-assisted framework to automate Transportation Management Plan (TMP) content generation using the WisDOT WisTMP system. It fine-tunes multiple open-source LLMs at different scales and deploys them locally for data security, building a domain-specific dataset from historical PDFs converted into structured QA pairs. Results show fine-tuning significantly improves text generation metrics, but models over-generate strategies and struggle with project-specific justifications and cost estimates, with limited gains from 7B/8B to 14B scaling.
